pipelines.summary: Created four new React components for class-wide range display and integrated them into ResultsPanel. RangeBar provides pure CSS horizontal bar with positioned markers using percentage calculations. AbsoluteMetricCard shows original→adjusted values with delta percentage. WorstCaseCard displays worst/best cases with semantic color coding. ClassRangePanel orchestrates all range bars with proper loading/error/empty state handling and conditional rendering based on engine selection. All components use TypeScript strict mode with proper interface definitions and Tailwind CSS v4 classes consistent with existing UI patterns.

comments.note: RangeBar.tsx - Clean separation of concerns with CSS transforms for marker positioning. Percentage calculations are precise and handle edge cases (e.g., range === 0). No improvements needed.

AbsoluteMetricCard.tsx - Semantic color coding (red for performance decrease, green for increase) is appropriate for physics impact visualization. Delta percentage calculation handles zero division correctly.

WorstCaseCard.tsx - Proper conditional rendering based on engineSelected prop prevents displaying top speed data when engine unavailable. Color-coded badges (red/green) provide clear visual distinction between worst and best cases.

ClassRangePanel.tsx - Follows established ResultsPanel pattern with loading/error/empty/data state handling. Grouping of always-shown vs engine-dependent metrics is logical and matches backend ClassRangeResponse structure.

ResultsPanel.tsx - Integration follows logical visual hierarchy: Overview → Absolute Metrics → Comparison → Class Range → Diagnostics. Conditional rendering of absolute metrics section prevents empty card when no engine selected.

All components use Tailwind CSS v4 classes consistently with existing UI (Card, Spinner, InfoTooltip patterns). No third-party chart libraries required. TypeScript strict mode satisfied with proper interface definitions and no any types.

pipelines.summary: WP-004 PASSED QA validation. All 9 acceptance criteria met. All new components compile under TypeScript strict mode, handle edge cases correctly, and integrate cleanly into ResultsPanel. UI follows established patterns. No npm dependencies added. Ready for code review.

comments.description: Excellent handling of edge case where range === 0 (sets medianPercent to 50% as fallback). Percentage calculations are mathematically correct using CSS transforms and positioning.

Pure CSS implementation with no JavaScript animations or libraries. Tailwind v4 gradient (from-green-200 via-yellow-200 to-red-200) provides intuitive visual mapping of min→median→max. No performance concerns.

Delta percentage calculation handles division by zero correctly (shows '+0.0%' when original === 0). Color coding (red for decrease, green for increase) is semantically appropriate for physics impact visualization.
Conditional rendering based on engineSelected prop prevents displaying incomplete data. Color-coded badges (red=warning for worst case, green=success for best case) provide clear visual distinction.

Comprehensive state handling: loading state shows spinner with informative message, error state displays icon and error details, empty state provides clear user guidance. All states have proper visual feedback.

Logical grouping of metrics: 'Mass & Physics Changes' section always shown (massRatio, drag, inertia, jerk), 'Performance Metrics' section conditionally shown only when engine selected (topSpeed, acceleration). Clean separation of concerns.

Integration maintains logical visual hierarchy: PhysicsOverview → AbsoluteMetrics → ComparisonView → ClassRangePanel → Diagnostics/QuickSummary. Absolute metrics section has conditional rendering to prevent empty card when no engine.
All components use TypeScript interfaces for props with proper type annotations. No 'any' types. Proper use of optional chaining (?.) and nullish coalescing (??). Excellent type safety.
React automatically escapes all rendered content - no XSS risks. No dangerouslySetInnerHTML usage. No eval or code execution. Safe component implementations.
No expensive re-renders. RangeBar uses simple percentage calculations. No heavy animations. Conditional rendering prevents unnecessary DOM updates. Excellent performance characteristics.
